hebrewText: וַ/הֲצֵרֹ֣תִי לָ/אָדָ֗ם וְ/הָֽלְכוּ֙ כַּֽ/עִוְרִ֔ים כִּ֥י לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה חָטָ֑אוּ וְ/שֻׁפַּ֤ךְ דָּמָ/ם֙ כֶּֽ/עָפָ֔ר וּ/לְחֻמָ֖/ם כַּ/גְּלָלִֽים

tokens.bdb: to cramp, literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive
tokens.kjv: adversary, (be in) afflict(-ion), beseige, bind (up), (be in, bring) distress, enemy, narrower, oppress, pangs, shut up, be in a strait (trouble), vex.

tokens.bdb: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] another, [phrase] hypocrite, [phrase] common sort, [idiom] low, man (mean, of low degree), person.
tokens.enLiteralWord: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species
tokens.explanation: adam — ser humano, homem, a humanidade como espécie
tokens.explanationEn: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species

tokens.bdb: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: (all) along, apace, behave (self), come, (on) continually, be conversant, depart, [phrase] be eased, enter, exercise (self), [phrase] follow, forth, forward, get, go (about, abroad, along, away, forward, on, out, up and down), [phrase] greater, grow, be wont to haunt, lead, march, [idiom] more and more, move (self), needs, on, pass (away), be at the point, quite, run (along), [phrase] send, speedily, spread, still, surely, [phrase] tale-bearer, [phrase] travel(-ler), walk (abroad, on, to and fro, up and down, to places), wander, wax, (way-) faring man, [idiom] be weak, whirl.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to walk (in a great variety of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: to walk (in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanation: to walk (in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanationEn: to walk (in a great variety of applications

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: properly, to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference, to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn
tokens.kjv: bear the blame, cleanse, commit (sin), by fault, harm he hath done, loss, miss, (make) offend(-er), offer for sin, purge, purify (self), make reconciliation, (cause, make) sin(-ful, -ness), trespass.

tokens.bdb: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
tokens.kjv: cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed(-der, out), slip.

tokens.bdb: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: blood  of man or an animal; by analogy
tokens.enLiteralWord: blood  of man or an animal; by analogy
tokens.explanation: blood  of man or an animal; by analogy
tokens.explanationEn: blood  of man or an animal; by analogy

tokens.bdb: dust (as powdered or gray); hence, clay, earth, mud
tokens.kjv: ashes, dust, earth, ground, morter, powder, rubbish.

tokens.bdb: properly, eaten, i.e. food; also flesh, i.e. body
